# Susan Baker

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** Maid-of-all-work and domestic helper for the Blythe family at Ingleside  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Susan is a grim-faced, gray, and elderly spinster with a grim appearance. She is known for her distinct opinions on physical traits, such as expressing a strong preference regarding the shape of men's ears.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Susan is a kind-hearted, fiercely loyal, and devoted household helper who considers Ingleside her world and takes great pride in her domestic domain. Pragmatic, straightforward, and serenely unbothered by trying to fix the wider world, she goes about her work methodically while maintaining strong, opinionated views on family rearing and community members. She derives great enjoyment from discussing neighborhood gossip and morbid subjects such as funerals, yet remains deeply compassionate and fiercely protective of those under her care, especially young Shirley.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v5 c1 P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004), [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v5 c15 P3](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0003), [v5 c26 P9](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0009)_

## History

Susan Baker was installed as maid-of-all-work at the little house of dreams to care for Anne Blythe. Following the difficult birth of Shirley, during which Anne was gravely ill, Susan mothered the baby with passionate tenderness, claiming that she gave him life just as much as his mother did. When Dr. Blythe once spanked Shirley, Susan became so indignantly upset that she refused to bake the doctor a pie for weeks. Over time, she moved with the family to Ingleside, establishing herself as the supreme ruler of the household whose domestic authority even Anne rarely questioned. While Dr. and Mrs. Blythe spent three months at a medical congress in Europe, Susan took Shirley to her brother's home to enjoy having him to herself before returning to run the Ingleside home.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006), [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007)_
